newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile foreign minister denies wine dumping report.
newsitem.headline: Chile foreign minister denies wine dumping report.

text.p: Chilean Foreign Minister Jose Miguel Insulza denied Tuesday a media report that U.S. wine-makers have accused Chilean producers of receiving illegal susidies and dumping wine in the American market.
"We do not have officially, or unofficially, any information about any accusation against any Chilean products apart from salmon," Insulza told reporters.
"If we had any, naturally we would be the first to give information about the issue."
His comments follow a report from a U.S. international television channel that Californian winemakers have complained that Chilean wine exports to the United States are receiving illegal subsidies.
Chilean salmon producers are being investigated by the U.S. International Trade Commission after dumping complaints from American salmon farmers.
